messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — webinar landing + SEO ops. We go live Tues 03/31 (AM). Need final redirect map, structured data for webinar schema, internal linking plan from blog + docs, and inbound lead routing to SFDC. Can @Tom handle redirects + canonical checks? Also need a short benchmark narrative paragraph for webinar page. TL;DR: hooked to demo signups and gated report.

Tom Alvarez: On it. I'll do redirect map + canonical sweep. Do we have a list of old URLs to consolidate?

Maya Chen: yes, Priya exported top 20 from GA4. Priya — can you paste the sheet and a short hero paragraph for benchmark narrative?

Priya Singh: Sheet here: https://docs.google.com/sheets/d/1X_example_view (view/comment). Hero paragraph draft below. "Redwood's new dedicated inference delivers 3x latency reduction at 1/2 the cost on demo workloads — join the webinar to see the benchmarks and how to replicate them." LMK edits.

Alex R.: Heads up — for lead routing, we need the webhook + hidden fields on form. We currently map UTM->campaign->lead_owner via /api/lead-proxy. I'll add the fields.

Maya Chen: Good. For structured data, let's use Webinar schema (schema.org/Event) + Talk/Thing for speakers. Tom, add JSON-LD snippet in head.

Tom Alvarez: Draft redirect mapping (short): 
```
/webinar-old -> /webinar-2026-dedicated (301)
/blog/inference-cost -> /blog/inference-cost-2026 (301)
```
I'll run Screaming Frog tonight.

Priya Singh: Benchmark paragraph: "In internal benchmarks on common instruction-following tasks, Redwood Dedicated achieved median p95 latency of 120ms and reduced cost per 1k tokens by 48% vs baseline. The webinar demo reproduces these numbers on a realistic demo query set." Use that.

Maya Chen: Nice. Can someone add internal links from: /blog/infra, /docs/deploy, /case-studies/ai to the landing? Priority to infra blog and deploy docs.

Alex R.: I'll add link snippets in the CMS. Also need to confirm redirect TTL on CDN — ops-bot, any restrictions?

ops-bot: CDN change window available 03/28 01:00-03:00 UTC. 301s ok. Deploy request required 24h notice.

Maya Chen: Perfect. Final checklist: redirects mapped (Tom), JSON-LD in head (Tom), hero + benchmark paragraph + gated-report link (Priya), internal links in CMS (Alex), lead webhook + hidden fields (Alex), run canonical checks (Tom). I'll assemble one-pager and send to stakeholders by EOD.

Tom Alvarez: Will ping when Screaming Frog run is done. :thumbsup:

Priya Singh: I'll post final copy in the sheet by 4pm.

Alex R.: Leaving a quick snippet for JSON-LD:
```
<script type=\"application/ld+json\"> 
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Dedicated: Inference at Scale - Webinar","startDate":"2026-03-31T18:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar-2026-dedicated"},"performer":[{"@type":"Person","name":"Maya Chen"}],"description":"Demo + benchmarks for production inference economics."}
</script>
```

Maya Chen: Thanks team — I'll pull these into the launch doc. @channel please react with :white_check_mark: when tasks are done.
